title: Gauntlet: stage packs, expertise packs, fingerprint-bound evidence
objective: Implement the frozen gauntlet design (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-gauntlet-roles-design.md): shared fingerprint tooling, role/expertise packs with schemas, four-valued verification with gate-policy exemptions, evidence-chain enforcement, agent-context gauntlet view, and the full §12 self-test battery.
acceptance: docs/agents/README.md records the §2 authority hierarchy and the advisory MUST-NOT rule
scripts/candidate-fingerprint produces deterministic candidate and task digests offline; the candidate digest excludes .agent/work, .agent/reports, .agent/logs and .scratch
./scripts/selftest exits 0 with every §12 matrix row covered
./scripts/verify-candidate exits 0 task-less and for FJ-PRD-001 and FJ-043
gate-policy.json carries exactly the four v1 exemptions, each tracked by an existing non-complete work item
deliberately staged candidate-stale and task-stale runs fail with stage.evidence_stale and recover after restore
nonGoals: No workflow engine, no new status vocabulary, no stage history database (design §14)
No product Go code, no harness-specific files, no generated persona prompts
No jsonschema dependency: schemas are contracts, the validator enforces them directly
nextAction: Rollout complete and verified; pick up the next work item.
notes: Umbrella item for the gauntlet rollout; its stage artifacts are recorded retroactively at the end of the plan (see plan task 11, design interpretation note 13).
Lifecycle condensed to ready -> review because the stages were executed as this plan's documentation and tooling work; there is no workflow engine enforcing transitions.
